quarterly_data.quarter: Xiaomi HKEX announcement: Results Announcement for the Three and Six Months Ended (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Statutory results (results announcement): Q2 2026 profit for the period RMB9,463.4 million, down 20.3% year-over-year, and operating profit RMB10,870.2 million (-19.1%), including fair value gains of RMB6,457.7 million on financial instruments and other income of RMB2,159.6 million, mainly subsidy income. H1 2026 revenue RMB208,063.2 million (-8.4%), gross profit RMB43,419.0 million (-15.7%) and adjusted net profit RMB12,291.2 million (-42.8%). Q2 gross margin 19.8%, versus 22.5% a year earlier and 22.0% in Q1 2026. Revenue outside the Chinese Mainland, mainly from Europe and India, was 36.0% of Q2 revenue (31.6% a year earlier).
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 profit RMB9,463.4 million (-20.3%); H1 revenue RMB208,063.2 million (-8.4%); H1 adjusted net profit RMB12,291.2 million (-42.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Xiaomi HKEX announcement: Results Announcement for the Three and Six Months Ended (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Smartphones and component costs (results announcement): Q2 smartphone shipments fell 26.5% year-over-year from 42.4 million to 31.2 million units (33.8 million in Q1 2026), attributed to product-portfolio optimization, fewer mid-range and low-end models and weakened global demand driven by the continued increase in price of key components; ASP rose 25.9% to a record RMB1,351.0 per unit (RMB1,073.2 a year earlier, RMB1,310.1 in Q1), helped by the Xiaomi 17T Series launched in May 2026. Smartphone gross margin fell from 11.5% to 8.5% and IoT and lifestyle products gross margin from 22.5% to 20.1%, mainly due to the increased price of key components; the company cites Omdia for global smartphone shipments down 6% year-over-year in Q2 2026. Raw materials inventory was RMB45,260,017 thousand at June 30, 2026 versus RMB23,974,417 thousand at December 31, 2025; the Q2 inventory impairment provision was approximately RMB2,404,208,000.
quarterly_data.figure: shipments 31.2 million (-26.5%); ASP RMB1,351.0 (+25.9%); raw materials inventory RMB45,260,017 thousand (Dec 31, 2025: RMB23,974,417 thousand)

quarterly_data.quarter: Xiaomi HKEX announcement: Results Announcement for the Three and Six Months Ended (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Smart EV detail (results announcement): Q2 smart EV ASP RMB229,312 per unit, down 9.6% from RMB253,662 a year earlier (RMB235,116 in Q1 2026), mainly on a lower Xiaomi SU7 Ultra contribution; Q1 2026 deliveries were 80,856 units. Segment gross margin fell from 26.4% to 19.2% on the lower SU7 Ultra share, the increased price of key components and the increased cost of the AI business; segment operating expenses rose 25.7% to RMB7.4 billion. The Xiaomi SkyNomad Series uses a large-battery extended-range architecture, dual-motor all-wheel drive and the Xiaomi Kunlun 1.5T range-extender unit, with a CLTC combined range of up to 1,705 km.
quarterly_data.figure: smart EV ASP RMB229,312 (-9.6%); segment gross margin 19.2% (from 26.4%); SkyNomad CLTC range up to 1,705 km

quarterly_data.quarter: Xiaomi HKEX announcement: Results Announcement for the Three and Six Months Ended (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI, robotics and internet (results announcement): Xiaomi-Robotics-U0, launched and open-sourced in July 2026, is a 38-billion parameter multimodal autoregressive generative foundation model for embodied intelligence (ranked No. 1 among 126 models on the WorldArena benchmark, per the company); robots were also deployed at center console side-cover sorting in the final assembly workshop logistics area, at a 90% success rate. The Xiaomi HyperOS 4 beta launched in August 2026, with 'Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi 2.0' integrating the Xiaomi MiMo large language model; AI Assistant MAU reached 174.9 million in June 2026 (+14.2%). R&D expense growth was attributed especially to higher investments in AI infrastructure. Advertising revenue RMB7.2 billion (+4.8%); overseas internet services revenue RMB2.9 billion, 32.1% of internet services revenue; connected IoT devices (excluding smartphones and tablets) a record 1,160.8 million at June 30, 2026 (+17.4%); more than 270 large Xiaomi stores (over 500 square meters) in the Chinese Mainland as of June 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: Xiaomi-Robotics-U0 38-billion parameters; AI Assistant MAU 174.9 million; advertising RMB7.2 billion (+4.8%); 1,160.8 million connected IoT devices

quarterly_data.quarter: Xiaomi HKEX announcement: Results Announcement for the Three and Six Months Ended (08-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: India proceedings (contingencies note): since December 2021 Xiaomi India, a wholly-owned subsidiary, has been involved in investigations and notifications by the Indian Income Tax Department, the Directorate of Revenue Intelligence and the Directorate of Enforcement over income tax, customs duties and foreign exchange compliance; orders allege it inappropriately deducted costs including mobile phone purchase costs and royalty fees, certain of its bank accounts were attached, and INR 49,170,230,000 (equivalent to RMB3,535,831,000) was considered restrictive as of June 30, 2026. The cases are in hearing stages; management concluded Xiaomi India has valid grounds to respond and made no material provision.
